title: Part History search finds entries by text or staff, in any case
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-HSEARCH-01) is tracked at {Location-A}, and its Part History holds, from you, "Deactivated | Reason: ZZAUTOTEST Superseded Kit", "Activated" and "Tracking turned off" entries.
  • Your name as Part History shows it is {Staff-A} (for example Admin ShopView).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
  2. Type "superseded kit" in the search.
  3. Replace it with "TRACKING TURNED".
  4. Replace it with the first name of {Staff-A}, in lower case.
  5. Clear the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Only "Deactivated | Reason: ZZAUTOTEST Superseded Kit" is listed.
  • Step 3: Only "Tracking turned off" is listed.
  • Step 4: Every entry made by {Staff-A} is listed.
  • Step 5: All entries are back.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R27, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.8 (Finding it in Part History), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R27: “The Part History search finds an entry when the typed text appears in its Event text as shown on screen, or in its Staff name. Upper and lower case do not matter. This applies to every kind of entry.”
